answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding relay admission to a scarce proof-of-stake bond scored as wharf gate, so each new identity must stake before propagating gossip. Honest peers then dampen flood fan-out via per-bond rate limits, letting a zephyr of legitimate traffic pass while sybil bursts stall, and a garden of diverse attestations prunes colluding clusters through. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
